title: Encounter
description: A combat encounter: the participant list and inputs needed to check it against SF2E's XP-budget encounter math (see reference/tables/encounter-and-rewards-math.json) — distinct from challenge.schema.json (skill checks) and subsystem.schema.json (victory-point scenes), which don't use XP budgeting. A future validator can sum creatures[].level via the relative-level XP table and compare to encounterDifficultyThresholds for partySize.

partyLevel.description: The party level this specific fight is pitched at. Pilots, Frames and vehicles share one level (lockstep), so the same number applies whether the fight is at personnel scale, like Episode One's Flood Tunnel, or at Frame scale.

partySize.description: How many PCs/Frames are actually in this specific fight. Can be the full roster of six (a personnel-scale fight like Flood Tunnel) or fewer (not every Frame deployed for a given Contact) -- don't assume either.

intendedThreatLevel.description: The GM's design intent, to check against the computed budget.

creatureRef.description: id of a creature.schema.json file, if built.

level.description: Combat level, for XP-budget purposes even if creatureRef isn't set yet.

specialRules.description: Bespoke scripted overrides to normal encounter math, e.g. a win condition that is not the enemy being destroyed.

roundLimit.description: For a scripted fight with a fixed round count.
